title: TrustEd
description:
A decentralized, DAO-verified credential registry that proves your degree is real without ever exposing your data on-chain.

 Built collaboratively for the Christchurch Web3 Hackathon with:
 - [Sienna Robinson](https://github.com/itzsiennaduh) · [Ed Leonard](https://edleonard.dev/) · [Siegfried Weigler-Harding](https://github.com/walkingAroundsoMuch)
- [Reuben Donnison](https://reujdon.dev/) · [Darsh Gandhi](https://darshgandhi.dev/)
